invariants: PID ownership is established at creation/adoption time, never inferred after the fact.
Process creation timestamp (create_time) protects against Windows PID recycling hazards.
Pre-existing user processes/windows are marked existed_before=True and never closed by Astra.
Empty, None, or unverified resource identities fail closed as NOT_MATERIALIZED or INVALID_IDENTITY.
Unsuccessful cleanup remains FAILED_CLEANUP and halts positive completion.
